summary: Make reasoning-effort capability model-owned instead of inferred from control protocol: models explicitly declare supported canonical effort levels and an optional default; runtime request selection rejects stale unsupported effort values and falls back to the model-owned default; Web and Provider Admin render and persist those explicit facts without reusing reasoning_effort_map as a capability list.

components.owning_subsystem: existing provider registry, routed LLM client construction, request-scoped reasoning intent, and Web provider-administration authority
components.disposition: ADMIT as a narrowing of mechanical control: provider/model metadata owns the declared canonical effort set and default, while request-scoped human intent remains an override only when valid for the selected model. Existing reasoning_effort_map remains solely a canonical-label to provider/template-label translation map. No semantic task judgment is moved into program logic.
evidence: ProviderRegistry parses reasoning_efforts and reasoning_default_effort explicitly and no longer infers a universal effort list from always_on_effort or reasoning_effort_map.
LLMClient accepts a request effort only when the selected model declares it, otherwise falls back to the model-owned default and only then to the legacy global default when compatible.
always_on_effort preserves the existing mechanical contract that off/lowest intent keeps reasoning enabled and maps to low rather than sending thinking=disabled.
Provider Admin schema and runtime test path round-trip the new model-owned fields without introducing a second provider configuration store.
components.verification_level: Committed-state provider/client/pool/factory/provider-admin/API adjacent pytest, Ruff, Pyright, diff-check, staged/commit-hook security, Web product tests, and production Web build
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: The model/user remains free to select any declared effort through request intent; provider/model metadata is inspectable and editable through the existing Provider Admin authority; unsupported stale values are not silently forwarded. Reverting the implementation restores the prior global/inferred behavior without data migration.
components.rollback_route: Revert product commit ce2acb1a31b0cb01b38005712793194174f21fc0 and this manifest follow-up; no runtime data migration is required. Live provider metadata can be reverted independently through Provider Admin/CAS.

components.owning_subsystem: operator-facing Web model controls and provider configuration editor
components.disposition: ADMIT as presentation/editing of server-owned capability facts. ModelControls renders exactly the selected model's declared efforts and default; ProviderManager edits the same existing provider configuration authority. The browser owns no routing or provider truth.
evidence: GLM product fixture renders Auto(max), low/high/max, no medium, and no true Off for always_on_effort.
Provider editor persists reasoning_efforts and reasoning_default_effort through the existing provider-admin API.

components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Web controls are a view/editor only; server registry remains authoritative and unsupported/stale browser values are filtered again at runtime.
components.rollback_route: Revert with ce2acb1a31b0cb01b38005712793194174f21fc0; no browser storage migration is required.

g1.necessity: The previous /models catalog inferred low/medium/high from always_on_effort when a mapping was absent, while the global historical reasoning_effort default could override a model/provider-owned default. That conflated protocol shape, capability facts, and operator default authority, and could forward an effort selected for another model.

g2.authority_owner: the existing per-model ProviderRegistry metadata loaded by the existing provider configuration authority and consumed by ModelClientPool/LLMClient
g2.non_duplication: No new registry, state store, session authority, routing controller, or provider protocol is introduced. Two explicit fields are added to ModelSpec and carried through existing factory/pool/client/admin/catalog paths; reasoning_effort_map keeps its prior translation-only role.

model_evidence: selected model's explicit reasoning_efforts and reasoning_default_effort exposed in /api/v1/models
request-scoped current_reasoning_effort remains the explicit user/model intent carrier
wire payload regressions proving auto/default, explicit high/max, and stale unsupported effort behavior
Provider Admin round-trip facts for editable per-model capability
g3.recovery_or_reason: Operators can alter or remove model-owned effort metadata through the existing Provider Admin/CAS authority; explicit supported request effort wins; omitting the new metadata preserves legacy behavior for models not yet qualified. Session model authority and queued frozen effort ownership are unchanged.

g4.rollback: Revert ce2acb1a31b0cb01b38005712793194174f21fc0 and the docs-only A.5 follow-up. No schema migration, credential change, or persisted session rewrite is required; live provider metadata can be rolled back separately through Provider Admin/CAS.
